Shri Ram Prakash Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Amit Pandey - Public
Prosecutor for the State.

Heard on I.A. No.15622/2025 which is the third application under Section 430(1) of BNSS 2023/389 (1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant Ankit @ Lallu Kushwaha S/o Rohni Prasad Kushwaha.
The first application was dismissed on merits on 13/03/2020.
The second application was also dismissed on merits on 17/10/2024 without there being no change in the circumstances.

This appeal has been preferred against the judgment dated 12/04/2019 passed by the Special Sessions Judge, Shahdol, District Shahdol (M.P.) in S.T. No.45/2016, whereby the present appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
Conviction U/s. Sentence Fine In lieu of default 458 of IPC 10 years R.I. Rs.5,000/- 1 year R.I. 376(d) of IPC 20 years R.I. Rs.5,000/- 1 year R.I.

entities.text: Special Sessions Judge, Shahdol, District Shahdol (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that co-accused Madhav Baiga has been released on bail.
The allegation of rape is against present appellant Ankit @ Lallu Kushwaha.
The prosecutrix is a married lady aged about 24 years.
There are material contradictions in the statements of witnesses and the prosecution has 2 CRA-6968-2019 failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.
There is no previous criminal history of the appellant.
This appeal is of the year 2019 and conclusion of appeal will take time.
The appellant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be allowed.
Learned Public Prosecutor, on the other hand, has opposed the application for suspension of sentence and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial Court.
Keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the opinion that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant can be considered.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, I.A. No.15622/2025 is allowed.
